name: timeline-status-badge
title: Timeline Status Badge
description: A preconfigured badge for lifecycle timeline statuses (open, opening soon, closing soon, closed) with consistent colors and icons. Composes Badge internally.

docs.lead: A preconfigured badge for lifecycle timeline statuses with consistent colors, icons, and labels. Composes Badge internally.

examples.title: Open
examples.description: Green badge indicating an open/active status.

examples.title: Opening Soon
examples.description: Purple badge indicating a status that will open soon.

examples.title: Closing Soon
examples.description: Yellow badge indicating a status that is closing soon.

examples.title: Closed
examples.description: Red badge indicating a closed status.

examples.title: All Statuses
examples.description: All four timeline statuses side by side.

examples.title: Custom Label
examples.description: Override the default label via children for i18n or custom text.

api.name: TimelineStatusBadge
api.description: A preconfigured Badge that maps timeline lifecycle statuses to colors, icons, and labels.

props.name: children
props.description: Override the default label (useful for i18n)
